MACHINE-GENERATED from real `job.error` rows in server/data/identity.db (which is gitignored, so this
file is the only checked-in copy). Each `stdout`/`stderr` pair is the EXACT text a real failed
generation produced, recovered by splitting the stored message on the labels the old formatter wrote.

READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING `stdout`: it is only the LAST 1500 CHARACTERS of that run's real stdout,
because .slice(-1500) is all the old code preserved. The earlier bytes are gone forever, and that
loss IS dogfood finding G1. So `fanout`'s report head was destroyed (its `{` never made it into the
row) while `design`'s and `plan`'s happened to fit inside the window and survived intact.

Stored as JSON, not as .txt, on purpose: core.autocrlf=true on the machine this was captured on, so a
plain text fixture's line endings would depend on which OS cloned the repo. Inside a JSON string a
newline is an escaped 
, so these bytes survive any EOL translation of the file itself.
